name: table-09
description: Client-side paginated table with previous and next controls and a range label.

files.content:
"use client" import * as React from "react" import { ChevronLeft as ChevronLeftIcon, ChevronRight as ChevronRightIcon, } from "@designali/icons" import { Button } from "@workspace/ui/components/button" import { Table, TableBody, TableCell, TableHead, TableHeader, TableRow, } from "@workspace/ui/components/table" const transactions = Array.from({ length: 23 }, (_, i) => ({ id: "TX-" + (1040 + i), merchant: [ "Vercel", "Figma", "GitHub", "Notion", "Cursor", ][i % 5], amount: ((i * 37) % 180) + 4.75, })) const pageSize = 5 export default function PaginatedTable() { const [page, setPage] = React.useState(0) const pageCount = Math.ceil(transactions.length / pageSize) const rows = transactions.slice(page * pageSize, page * pageSize + pageSize) return (
ID Merchant Amount {rows.map((tx) => ( {tx.id} {tx.merchant} {"$" + tx.amount.toFixed(2)} ))}
{page * pageSize + 1}- {Math.min((page + 1) * pageSize, transactions.length)} of{" "} {transactions.length}
) }
